item.title: Bootsy Collins Signs Davie as First Artist to Bootzilla Records
item.description:
[Upbeat music fades out, and the host's voice comes in]
Host: "Welcome to Trending on Billboard, I'm your host. Today, we're talking about a major milestone in the music industry. Bootsy Collins, the legendary funk artist, has just launched his own label, Bootzilla Records, and he's signed his first artist - the talented roots-soul singer-songwriter, Davie.
[Short clip of Bootsy Collins' music plays in the background]
Host: "According to Bootsy, Davie brings 'real soul, grit, and that feel-good fire' to his music. And with Bootzilla Records being distributed through Jay-Z's Roc Nation, we can expect big things from this new partnership.
[Clip of Davie's music plays]
Host: "Davie is thrilled to be working with Bootsy, citing the legend's unique sound and ability to connect with audiences everywhere. And to celebrate Juneteenth, Davie has just released his label debut single, 'Soul', which draws from a rich history of blues, soul, and funk.
[Clip of 'Soul' by Davie plays]
Host: "As Davie says, 'Black music has always been the soundtrack of our cultural expression', and 'Soul' is the perfect representation of that. So, be sure to check out Davie's new song and stay tuned for more updates from Bootzilla Records. That's all for today, thanks for tuning in to Trending on Billboard."
[Outro music starts playing]
